name: Swan-Neck Deformity
definition: Finger deformity characterized by PIP hyperextension with DIP flexion due to tendon/ligament imbalance, rheumatoid disease, trauma or neurological conditions.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is mainly clinical; radiographs assess joint damage or arthritis.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when the condition-specific question requires soft-tissue, neural, marrow or occult-injury assessment.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs/CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Fixed or function-limiting deformity may require hand surgery.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Anguli/Snayu deformity phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Finger deformity characterized by PIP hyperextension with DIP flexion due to tendon/ligament imbalance, rheumatoid disease, trauma or neurological conditions.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
